IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Tactical HE Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A tactical high-explosive warhead utilizing repurposed mortar shells. It delivers a reliable explosive force to the target area.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Tactical Cluster Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A tactical high-explosive warhead with cluster shells. It delivers a reliable explosive force to a wide area.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Tactical Inferno Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A devastating incendiary warhead that uses standard incendiary shells as its core. It creates a massive area of intense heat and fire upon impact.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Tactical Corrosive Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A specialized warhead that disperses highly corrosive chemical agents. It is extremely effective at melting through thick armor and fortified structures without the indiscriminate fire risk of incendiary payloads.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Tactical Cryogenic Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A high-tech warhead that triggers a rapid endothermic reaction, plunging the impact zone into absolute zero. It inflicts severe frostbite on biological targets and can shatter delicate mechanisms, all while leaving the local environment and structures relatively intact.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Tactical Psychic Shock Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: An advanced non-lethal (or lethal, depending on intensity) payload that releases a focused burst of neuro-active impulses. It bypasses physical armor to attack the nervous system directly, causing immediate paralysis or neural collapse in organic life forms. Mechanical threats are completely unaffected.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Tactical Thermobaric Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A highly advanced aerosol-dispersal warhead. It releases a cloud of fuel that is subsequently ignited, creating a massive, long-duration pressure wave and high-intensity heat. The extreme conditions are capable of vaporizing biological tissues and collapsing even the most reinforced structures.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Tactical Molecular Fission Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: An advanced tactical warhead that utilizes the principle of material resonance to trigger a high-frequency molecular bond breaking chain reaction. It can sustain an incredibly deep chain reaction in dense areas.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Tactical Antimatter Disintegration Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: The ultimate tactical payload, converting a rare antigrain warhead into a missile-delivered weapon. It will cause a chain reaction of annihilation, destroying everything within the blast radius.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Tactical Suppression Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A specialized hybrid warhead designed for mass crowd control. It releases a massive concussive wave combined with an electromagnetic pulse, capable of neutralizing both organic infantry and mechanical threats over a vast area.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Tactical Mini-Nuke Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A compact high-intensity nuclear device. While it lacks the scale of strategic ICBM payloads, it provides unparalleled tactical destruction within the combat zone without world-map contamination.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Bunker Buster AP Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: Combining drill-down tech with AP munitions, this warhead is designed to penetrate underground structures. Lethal against fortified positions.\nWhile using this warhead, you can click the top bar to switch maps and aim at the underground map or the pocket space.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: AA Fragmentation Interceptor
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A fragmentation interceptor designed for anti-aircraft defense. Not very effective against missiles.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: AA Kinetic Interceptor
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: An kinetic interceptor designed for anti-missile defense. Needs precise timing and high-speed interception.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: AA Quantum Seeker
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: An ultra-tech interceptor with quantum-entangled sensors, providing superior tracking and extremely low lock-break risk.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Extinction-Class Strategic Nuclear Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A traditional ultimate deterrent. It vaporizes entire maps through a massive thermonuclear reaction. Its high yield comes at the cost of global radioactive fallout and direct escalation of the doomsday clock.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Scavenger Clean Strategic Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: Utilizes radiation-enhancement technology to vaporize matter structures without leaving long-term physical pollutants. The reduction in nuclear material is offset by high-purity focusers. Its use is still recognized as total nuclear war by monitoring systems.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Silent Surgical Strategic Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: Vaporizes targets with localized fallout using minimal nuclear material. Its energy signature is masked by extremely expensive signal-dampening hulls, allowing it to evade doomsday alert protocols. The immense cost reflects the complexity of hiding a strategic strike from the global doomsday clock.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Strategic Gravitational Singularity Fission Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: An archotech singularity device controlled by a persona core. It creates a temporary gravitational anomaly that swallows entire maps, and can even dig the whole deepest underground facilities out. Structures within the anomaly's reach will be torn apart by the distorted gravitational forces, leaving behind only the raw materials that composed them.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Gamma-Ray Burst Strategic Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A highly advanced weapon that unleashes a focused burst of high-energy gamma radiation. It is designed to sweep the surface and penetrate the deepest bunkers, instantly neutralizing all biological life signs without damaging structures or causing long-term environmental fallout. It bypasses doomsday detection due to its clean energy signature.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Tactical Deadlife Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A specialized warhead that disperses Deadlife dust upon detonation. This dust will reanimate any corpses in the area as friendly shamblers to attack enemies. Requires Anomaly research and bioferrite for production.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Tactical Aerosol Smoke Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A non-lethal tactical warhead designed to saturate a massive area with vision-blocking smoke. Ideal for masking friendly movement or neutralizing enemy turret fire over large defensive lines.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Tactical Tox-Cloud Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A chemical warhead designed to release a persistent, high-density toxic cloud over a wide area. It inflicts rapid toxic buildup on any biological life within the cloud. Requires Biotech research and tox shells for production.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Tactical Drilling Mine Distributor Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A tactical warhead designed to distribute mines over a wide area.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Tactical Drilling Luciferium Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A tactical warhead designed to drill through armor and release Luciferium over a wide area.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Recon Satellite
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A reconnaissance satellite powered by a small fusion core. Upon launch, it enters orbit to provide continuous observation of a target location.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Orbital Energy Beam Satellite
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A specialized satellite equipped with a high-intensity orbital energy beam projector. Once deployed into orbit, it can be commanded to fire a devastating beam of energy at a surface target. The satellite requires significant downtime between shots to recharge its capacitors.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Strategic Solar Flare Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A high-tech strategic payload designed to trigger a localized solar flare effect through high-altitude EMP bursts. It completely disables electronics and causes localized atmospheric disturbances without advancing the global doomsday clock.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Strategic Cloud-Seeding Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A strategic weather-modification payload. Instead of delivering destructive force, it disperses localized cooling agents and nucleation seeds into the upper atmosphere to trigger immediate rainfall. It has no offensive capabilities and does not escalate the global doomsday clock.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Strategic Thunderstorm Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A strategic payload designed to destabilize the local ionosphere. Upon impact, it triggers a massive dry thunderstorm accompanied by intense lightning strikes. It inflicts minor concussive damage to surface targets and creates long-term atmospheric instability.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Strategic Deep Freeze Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: An advanced endothermic payload that rapidly absorbs thermal energy from the environment. It triggers an immediate, severe cold snap and heavy snowfall, plunging the target area into a localized mini-ice age.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Strategic Blood Rain Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A dark-tech payload that utilizes forbidden archotech resonance to condense blood-like fluid in the clouds. The falling ichor drives biological organisms into a berserk frenzy. Requires Anomaly-level synchronization.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Strategic Volcanic Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A tectonic-disruption payload that triggers localized volcanic activity. It causes a rain of molten debris to shower the target area, igniting everything it touches.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Strategic Vacuum Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A highly advanced payload that temporarily rips a hole in the atmosphere, exposing the surface to the void of space. This triggers a localized orbital environment effect.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Orbital Bombardment Satellite
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A specialized satellite equipped with a rapid-fire kinetic impactor magazine. Once deployed into orbit, it can be commanded to saturate a target area with multiple kinetic strikes over a short duration.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Quantum Entanglement Tractor Satellite
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A specialized satellite equipped with high-energy quantum entanglement projectors. Once deployed into orbit, it can create a momentary link between two distant points in space-time, allowing for the instantaneous mass transport of all items from one map to a specific location on another.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Kinetic AP Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: An advanced kinetic warhead for railgun shells, designed for maximum penetration and destructive power.

IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.label: Tactical Plasma Warhead
IRBM.MissileWarheadDef.description: A specialized tactical warhead that fires a cluster of superheated plasma.
